content_sections.heading: Goa SBB Finance Controller Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate in Commerce with knowledge of Govt. rules and accounting procedures. Fluency in written and spoken English and Konkani. Proficiency in Computer and Tally. At least 2 years of experience in financial management. Resident of Goa with a 15 years residence certificate.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Goa SBB Finance Controller Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Goa SBB recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Goa State Biodiversity Board recruitment is Finance Controller.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Finance Controller post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Finance Controller post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Finance Controller position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Finance Controller position is Rs. 25,000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Finance Controller post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Finance Controller post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications required for the Finance Controller role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to be a Graduate in Commerce with knowledge of government rules, accounting procedures, fluency in English and Konkani, computer and Tally proficiency, and at least 2 years of financial management experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the date for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview venue is at the Goa SBB office in Bardez, Goa (Pincode: 403511).

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
